LESSON: HOMEMADE SUN DRYER

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.2: Homemade Sun Dryer

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Homemade Sun Dryer. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Homemade Sun Dryer
2. Practise Homemade Sun Dryer at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Homemade Sun Dryer

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Homemade Sun Dryer
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Homemade Sun Dryer. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Homemade Sun Dryer at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Homemade Sun Dryer at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Homemade Sun Dryer
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Homemade Sun Dryer. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Homemade Sun Dryer using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Homemade Sun Dryer in the examples.
2. Explain Homemade Sun Dryer to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Homemade Sun Dryer.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Homemade Sun Dryer using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Homemade Sun Dryer important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Homemade Sun Dryer
2. Practise Homemade Sun Dryer at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Homemade Sun Dryer

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
